title: EA-MPAI-SEMEX-01 v1.0 Metadata Packet for AI Indexing — Bridge (Disciplinary Clarification)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A bridge packet distinguishing **semantic exhaustion**, a proposed Semantic Economy concept for cumulative loss of meaning-bearing structure in public knowledge systems, from **semantic satiation**, the established temporary psychological effect in which repeated exposure makes a word briefly feel meaningless.

The packet separates the two by scale, mechanism, duration, object, reversibility, and method. Semantic satiation concerns an individual word–meaning link and recovers after repetition stops. Semantic exhaustion concerns provenance, lineage, context, and structural depth lost through repeated machine-mediated compression and requires active restoration rather than rest.
